why: cmux https://github.com/manaflow-ai/cmux/issues/51768: the hover card's split miniature needs the App's tab previews. The App only wires them: SidebarBridge sets SidebarView.tabPictures to TabPreviewSource.previewImage, AppServices hands TabPreviewSource the made chat views and calls AgentPanePictures.willLeaveScreen from TabContentCache.onConceal, and TabContentCache gains that one hook. The picture store, its refresh and drawing are in CmuxNextSidebar (SidebarTabThumbnails, WorkspacePaneShapeView), and when a chat is pictured is in CmuxNextAgentPane (AgentPanePictures).
